import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission_null.csv")


# Function to clean text by removing surrounding quotes if present
def clean_text(text):
    if isinstance(text, str):
        # Strip leading/trailing quotes that might surround the content
        return text.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
    return text


# Apply cleaning to the Comment column
train_df["Comment"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)
test_df["Comment"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)

# Separate features and target
X_train_full = train_df["Comment"]
y_train = train_df["Insult"]
X_test = test_df["Comment"]

# Stratified split to create a genuine hold-out set
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# TF-IDF Vectorization
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 2), max_features=50000, lowercase=True, stop_words="english"
)

X_train_vec = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train)
X_val_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_val)
X_test_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_test)

# Initialize and train model on training fold only
model = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=100, random_state=42, n_jobs=-1)
model.fit(X_train_vec, y_train)

# Evaluate on hold-out set (AUC-ROC)
val_preds = model.predict_proba(X_val_vec)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_preds)

# Retrain on all training data
all_train_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_train_full)
model_final = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=100, random_state=42, n_jobs=-1)
model_final.fit(all_train_vec, y_train)

# Predict on test set
test_preds = model_final.predict_proba(X_test_vec)[:, 1]

# Create submission dataframe
# Prioritize instruction: "All predictions should be in the first column"
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"predicted_insult": test_preds})

# Append original test info to maintain order/context (optional but safe)
submission_df["Comment"] = test_df["Comment"]
submission_df["Date"] = test_df["Date"]

# Ensure submission file location
submission_path = "./submission/submission.csv"
submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)

# Print evaluation metric only
print(val_auc)
